description: A Databricks notebook containing Python code for MLFlow auto-logging, LangChain setup, custom prompt templates, model invocation with OpenAI and Databricks models, and helper functions for handling chat messages. The notebook appears to set up and demonstrate a conversational AI with integrations for MLFlow, LangChain, and Databricks services.

methods.name: extract_user_query_string
methods.description: Extracts the user's question content from the chat messages array.

methods.name: extract_chat_history
methods.description: Extracts the chat history (all messages except the last) from the chat messages array.
